_comment: Hull classes, world bible section 6. Names and prose live here; the numbers live in sim/constants.ts, keyed by size, so both fleets are balanced identically and only their names and character differ. There are deliberately no fighters: a small craft is just a small ship, so the range is small / medium / large, with the transport off to one side. Three classes are unique: the Pirate Lords' own ships, which cannot be built, cost nothing to keep, and carry a power each.

classes.name: Sovereign
classes.blurb: A first-rate of the line, built straight and warded with cultivated coral. Nothing afloat hits harder or takes more killing. Slow to arrive anywhere.

classes.name: Razorback
classes.blurb: A heavy frigate. Cheap for what it carries, quick enough to be useful, and outmatched by anything of the line.

classes.name: Kestrel
classes.blurb: A sloop-of-war. The fastest thing the Crown puts to sea and the first to sink. Good for closing a harbour cheaply.

classes.name: Fluyt
classes.blurb: An unarmed merchantman pressed into service. Carries more companies than anything else and cannot defend itself at all.

classes.name: Reef-class
classes.blurb: Grown, not built — a living coral hull the Reef-folk sing into shape over years. No two alike. Enormous, and in no hurry.

classes.name: Tempest
classes.blurb: A frigate patched together out of three others. Not pretty. Holds its own against anything short of a ship of the line.

classes.name: Swift
classes.blurb: A schooner, stolen and re-rigged. Outruns everything on the water and comes apart if anything catches it.

classes.name: Brig
classes.blurb: A blunt-nosed hauler. No guns worth the name, but it lands companies where they are wanted.

classes.name: Free Harbor
classes.blurb: Commodore-Elect Adaira Hale's ship, and the Confederacy's floating parliament. Corwin Calloway's old coral-grown three-decker, named for what he meant her to be: any deck of his was a free harbour to anyone the Crown wanted. The Moot sits on her quarterdeck. Wherever she lies at anchor the island comes round to the Confederacy a point a day, and she is home to anyone coming back from a parley.

classes.name: Swallowtail
classes.blurb: Captain Silas Reyne's coral-grown sloop, which should not be as fast as she is. Faster than anything afloat, and the last thing in a harbour the enemy's guns can find: while another Confederate hull floats beside her, she is not hit.

classes.name: Ironback
classes.blurb: The Crown dreadnought Admiral Dorian Jessup took with him when he left the Imperium's service. The heaviest guns on the water, and every Confederate fleet lying in her harbour fights under his command.
